zh: 帮我看下我那单到哪了，预计哪天能到
en: Can you check where my order is and when it's expected to arrive?

zh: 单号 SF1234567890 现在什么情况
en: What's the status of tracking number SF1234567890?

zh:
用户：我昨天下的单发货了吗
客服：您的订单已于今早发出。
用户：好的，那大概什么时候能到
en:
User: Has the order I placed yesterday shipped?
Agent: Your order shipped this morning.
User: Great, so roughly when will it arrive?

zh: 我嘅快递而家去到边度啦
en: Where's my parcel at right now?

zh: 不用催发货，已经发了，我就想看看物流到哪了
en: No need to rush the shipment, it's already been sent. I just want to see where it is.

zh: 下单三天了还没发货，麻烦催一下
en: I ordered three days ago and it still hasn't shipped. Please hurry them up.

zh: 付完款一直显示待发货，到底啥时候发
en: It's said awaiting shipment ever since I paid. When on earth will it ship?

zh: 急用！！能不能今天就给我发出去
en: I need it urgently!! Can you ship it out today?

zh: 发货速度能不能快点，等到花儿都谢了
en: Can you ship any faster? I've been waiting forever.

zh:
用户：我 18 号下的单
客服：请问有什么可以帮您？
用户：到今天还是待发货，帮我催催
en:
User: I placed an order on the 18th.
Agent: How can I help you?
User: It's still awaiting shipment today. Please chase it up.

zh: 收货地址填错了，能改吗
en: I entered the wrong delivery address. Can I change it?

zh: 我搬家了，东西别寄到老地方
en: I've moved, don't send it to my old place.

zh: 收件人电话写成我同事的了，帮我换成我自己的
en: I put my coworker's phone number as the recipient's. Please change it to mine.

zh: 還沒發貨的話，幫我把地址改成公司
en: If it hasn't shipped yet, please change the address to my office.

zh:
用户：这单能今天发吗
客服：可以的，今天下午发出。
用户：等下，先别发，地址我要换一下
en:
User: Can this order ship today?
Agent: Yes, it'll go out this afternoon.
User: Wait, hold off, I need to change the address.

zh: 物流显示已签收，可我根本没收到
en: Tracking says delivered, but I never got it.

zh: 箱子到的时候已经压扁了，里面的杯子碎了两个
en: The box was crushed when it arrived and two of the cups inside were broken.

zh: 快递好像丢了，一个礼拜没有任何更新
en: My parcel seems to be lost. No updates at all for a week.

zh: 签收人不是我，我也没授权别人代收
en: Someone else signed for it, and I never authorized anyone to receive it for me.

zh: 個包裹話簽收咗，但係我冇收到喎
en: It says the parcel was signed for, but I didn't get it.

zh: 衣服收到了不喜欢，想退货
en: Got the clothes but don't like them. I want to return them.

zh: 7天无理由还能用吗，东西我还没拆
en: Can I still use the 7-day no-reason return? I haven't even opened it.

zh: 不是不能用，就是跟图片差太多了，退了吧
en: It's not that it doesn't work, it just looks nothing like the photos. I'll return it.

zh: 买的鞋子踩雷了，退退退
en: These shoes were a total dud. Return, return, return.

zh: 不用换新的，直接给我退货退钱
en: I don't want a replacement, just let me return it for my money back.

zh: 鞋子大了一码，能换小一码吗
en: The shoes are a size too big. Can I swap for one size smaller?

zh: 颜色发错了，我要的是黑色，给我换一下
en: You sent the wrong color. I ordered black. Please swap it.

zh: 不想退，就想换个没瑕疵的
en: I don't want to return it, I just want one without the defect.

zh: 件衫細咗，可唔可以換大一碼
en: The shirt's too small. Can I exchange it for a size up?

zh:
用户：上周买的电动牙刷
客服：请问遇到什么问题了？
用户：充不进电，给我换个新的
en:
User: The electric toothbrush I bought last week.
Agent: What problem are you having?
User: It won't charge. Give me a new one.

zh: 还没发货，我不想要了，帮我取消订单退款
en: It hasn't shipped yet and I don't want it anymore. Please cancel and refund.

zh: 东西一直没收到，也不想要了，直接退钱吧
en: I never received it and I don't want it anymore. Just refund me.

zh: 下错单了，刚付完款，能直接撤回吗
en: I placed the wrong order and just paid. Can I take it back right away?

zh: 拍错了拍错了，tk 一下
en: Ordered the wrong thing, oops. Refund pls.

zh: 不用寄回来是吧？商家说少发了一件，那件直接退钱就行
en: So I don't need to send anything back? The seller said they shipped one item short. Just refund that one.

zh: 退款申请了三天了，怎么还没到账
en: I applied for a refund three days ago. Why hasn't it arrived yet?

zh: 退货已经寄回去了，钱什么时候退
en: I already shipped the return back. When do I get my money?

zh: 上次那笔 tk 审核过了没
en: Has that refund from last time been approved yet?

zh: 不是没申请退款，申请了，一直没动静
en: It's not that I didn't request a refund. I did, and nothing has happened since.

zh:
用户：我要退款
客服：您的退款申请已在 5 号提交。
用户：对，就是那笔，现在到哪一步了
en:
User: I want a refund.
Agent: Your refund request was submitted on the 5th.
User: Right, that one. What stage is it at now?

zh: 买了三天就降价 200，能补差价吗
en: It dropped 200 yuan three days after I bought it. Can I get the difference back?

zh: 我刚买完你们就搞活动，这不是坑老用户吗，差价退给我
en: You ran a sale right after I bought it. That's a rip-off for loyal customers. Refund me the difference.

zh: 你们家有价保吗？我怕买了就降
en: Do you have price protection? I'm worried it'll drop right after I buy.

zh: 不是用优惠券的问题，是现在同款便宜了一百，想申请价保
en: It's not a coupon issue. The same item is now 100 cheaper and I want to claim price protection.

zh: 我啱啱買完就減價，可唔可以退返差價俾我
en: It went on sale right after I bought it. Can you give me back the difference?

zh: 帮我开一张电子发票
en: Please issue me an e-invoice.

zh: 公司报销要专票，可以开吗
en: My company needs a special VAT invoice for reimbursement. Can you issue one?

zh: 发票在哪里下载啊，订单详情里没找到
en: Where do I download the invoice? I couldn't find it on the order details page.

zh:
用户：订单已经收到了
客服：请问还有什么可以帮您？
用户：顺便把票开了吧，抬头写个人
en:
User: I've received the order.
Agent: Anything else I can help with?
User: Please issue the invoice too, made out to me personally.

zh: fa票能开公司抬头吗
en: can the invoce have my company name on it

zh: 发票抬头写错了，能重开吗
en: The invoice has the wrong company name. Can it be reissued?

zh: 税号少了一位，财务不收
en: The tax ID is missing a digit and finance won't accept it.

zh: 不是要开发票，已经开了，但是金额不对
en: I'm not asking for a new invoice. It's already issued, but the amount is wrong.

zh:
用户：发票收到了
客服：好的，请问还有其他问题吗？
用户：上面公司名称写成简称了，要全称
en:
User: I got the invoice.
Agent: Great, anything else?
User: It uses our company's short name. It needs the full legal name.

zh: 發票上的統一編號錯了，麻煩更正
en: The tax number on the invoice is wrong. Please correct it.

zh: 付款的时候一直提示支付失败
en: It keeps saying payment failed when I try to pay.

zh: 绑的银行卡付不了，换了张也不行
en: My linked bank card won't go through, and another card didn't work either.

zh: 付款页面一直转圈圈，蚌埠住了
en: The payment page just keeps spinning. I can't take it anymore.

zh: 不是扣了两次钱，是压根就付不进去
en: I wasn't charged twice. The payment just won't go through at all.

zh: Apple Pay 一直 failed 是什么情况
en: Why does Apple Pay keep failing?

zh: 同一个订单扣了我两次钱
en: I was charged twice for the same order.

zh: 钱已经扣了，订单还显示待付款
en: The money has been taken, but the order still says awaiting payment.

zh: 账单里多了一笔一模一样的消费，是你们重复扣款了吧
en: There's an identical extra charge on my statement. You charged me twice, right?

zh:
用户：刚才付款卡住了我又点了一次
客服：请问现在订单状态如何？
用户：订单只有一个，银行卡却少了两笔钱
en:
User: The payment froze just now so I tapped pay again.
Agent: What's the order status now?
User: There's only one order, but two payments came out of my card.

zh: 同一筆訂單被扣款兩次
en: The same order was charged twice.

zh: 优惠券领了用不了
en: I claimed a coupon but can't use it.

zh: 满 300 减 50 的券怎么没抵扣
en: Why didn't the 50-off-300 voucher get applied?

zh: 新人红包在哪领
en: Where do I claim the new-user red envelope?

zh: 价格没问题，就是结算的时候券没生效
en: The price is fine. It's just that the coupon didn't take effect at checkout.

zh: 这个 voucher 怎么 apply 不上
en: Why can't I apply this voucher?

zh: 我的积分怎么查
en: How do I check my points?

zh: 攒了一万积分能换点啥
en: I've saved up ten thousand points. What can I get with them?

zh: 我是金卡会员，包邮权益怎么没了
en: I'm a gold member. Why did my free shipping perk disappear?

zh: 续费了会员但等级没升上去
en: I renewed my membership but my tier didn't go up.

zh: 會員積分快過期了，怎麼延長
en: My member points are about to expire. How can I extend them?

zh: 登录一直提示密码错误
en: Login keeps saying my password is wrong.

zh: 收不到登录验证码
en: I'm not getting the login verification code.

zh: mm 忘了登不进去
en: forgot pw, can't get in

zh: 账号没被盗，就是我自己一直登不上去
en: My account wasn't hacked. I just can't log in myself.

zh: 我登入唔到個帳號，話我密碼錯
en: I can't log into my account, it says my password is wrong.

zh: 我的账号被盗了
en: My account has been hacked.

zh: 收到提醒说有陌生设备登录我的号
en: I got an alert that an unknown device logged into my account.

zh: 想把绑定的手机号换成新号
en: I want to change the phone number bound to my account to a new one.

zh: 这个账号我不用了，怎么注销
en: I don't use this account anymore. How do I delete it?

zh: 能登上去，但是有人用我的号下了单
en: I can log in fine, but someone placed an order using my account.

zh: 我要投诉这个商家
en: I want to file a complaint against this seller.

zh: 详情页写的纯棉，收到是化纤的，虚假宣传
en: The listing said pure cotton but what arrived is synthetic. That's false advertising.

zh: 商家客服骂人，这种店你们平台管不管
en: The seller's support rep swore at me. Does your platform do anything about shops like this?

zh: 不想换货了，这家店连续发错两次，我要投诉
en: I don't want another exchange. This shop sent the wrong item twice in a row. I want to file a complaint.

zh:
用户：我买的是 256G 的
客服：请问收到的是什么版本？
用户：128G 的，商家明显是故意的，我要投诉他
en:
User: I bought the 256 GB version.
Agent: Which version did you receive?
User: 128 GB. The seller clearly did it on purpose. I want to report them.

zh: 我要投诉快递员
en: I want to file a complaint about the courier.

zh: 快递员没打电话直接扔驿站了，我备注了送上门
en: The courier didn't call, just dumped it at the pickup station, even though I noted door delivery.

zh: 送快递的态度太差了，还骂人
en: The delivery guy was really rude and even swore at me.

zh: 包裹没丢也没坏，就是快递员把东西放门口没敲门
en: The package isn't lost or damaged. The courier just left it outside without knocking.

zh: 個速遞員成日唔送上樓，我要投訴佢
en: That courier never brings it upstairs. I want to complain about him.

zh: 转人工
en: Human agent.

zh: 别让机器人回复了，我要跟真人说
en: Stop the bot replies, I want to talk to a real person.

zh: 你听不懂，换个能听懂的人来
en: You don't understand. Get someone who can.

zh: 不投诉，就是这个问题比较复杂，想找人工客服聊
en: I'm not complaining. It's just a complicated issue and I'd like to talk to a human agent.

zh: 人工人工人工
en: Agent agent agent.

zh: 看下 order-service 的内存用了多少
en: Check how much memory order-service is using.

zh: node-12 磁盘是不是快满了
en: Is node-12's disk about to fill up?

zh: 这几台机器最近是不是很吃 CPU
en: Have these machines been eating a lot of CPU lately?

zh: 不用设告警，就想看现在各节点的内存水位
en: No need to set up an alert, I just want to see the current memory levels on each node.

zh: 帮我看下 prod 集群的 CPU usage
en: Show me the CPU usage of the prod cluster.

zh: 支付接口现在 QPS 多少
en: What's the payment API's QPS right now?

zh: 下单接口 P99 是不是涨了
en: Has the order API's P99 gone up?

zh: 用户反馈 App 很卡，看下网关响应时间
en: Users say the app is laggy. Check the gateway's response time.

zh: 不用写 PromQL，直接告诉我 5xx 错误率是多少
en: No need to write PromQL, just tell me what the 5xx error rate is.

zh:
用户：昨晚大促
助手：请问需要看哪个服务？
用户：搜索服务，峰值流量到多少了
en:
User: Big sale last night.
Assistant: Which service do you want to look at?
User: Search. How high did peak traffic get?

zh: 帮我写个 PromQL 算每个接口的错误率
en: Write me a PromQL query for the error rate of each endpoint.

zh: histogram_quantile 这个函数怎么用
en: How do I use the histogram_quantile function?

zh: 我这条查询为啥返回空：sum(rate(http_requests_total{job='api'}[5m]))
en: Why does my query return nothing: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job='api'}[5m]))

zh: 不是要看数据，是想学下 rate 和 irate 有啥区别
en: I don't need data, I want to learn the difference between rate and irate.

zh: 这个 by (instance) 加在哪里才对
en: Where should I put this by (instance) for it to work?

zh: 现在有哪些告警在响
en: Which alerts are firing now?

zh: 昨晚凌晨两点那个告警是什么原因触发的
en: What triggered that alert at 2 am last night?

zh: 告警群被刷屏了，都是啥
en: The alert channel is flooded. What is all that?

zh: 不是要改阈值，就想看看这周一共响了多少次告警
en: I'm not changing thresholds, I just want to see how many alerts fired this week.

zh: 查一下支付服務目前的告警
en: Check the payment service's current alerts.

zh: 帮我把 test 环境的告警静默两小时
en: Silence alerts in the test environment for two hours.

zh: 今晚做数据库迁移，这段时间别报警
en: We're migrating the database tonight. No alerts during that window.

zh: 这个告警一直重复发，先让它闭嘴
en: This alert keeps repeating. Shut it up for now.

zh: 不用改规则，就是维护窗口内临时屏蔽一下
en: No need to change the rule, just mute it temporarily during the maintenance window.

zh: 帮我 mute 一下 disk 相关的 alert，到明早
en: Mute the disk-related alerts until tomorrow morning.

zh: 给订单服务加一条错误率超过 1% 就告警的规则
en: Add a rule to alert when the order service error rate exceeds 1%.

zh: 磁盘使用率 85% 的阈值太敏感了，改成 90%
en: The 85% disk usage threshold is too sensitive. Change it to 90%.

zh: 告警别打电话了，改成发钉钉
en: Stop phoning me for alerts, send DingTalk messages instead.

zh: 不是要静默，是这条规则本身写错了，要改表达式
en: I don't want to silence it. The rule itself is wrong and the expression needs fixing.

zh:
用户：刚才那个 CPU 告警
助手：是 node-3 的 CPU 超过 80%。
用户：以后超过 95% 再报吧
en:
User: That CPU alert just now.
Assistant: It's node-3's CPU going over 80%.
User: From now on only alert above 95%.

zh: 查一下今天 order-service 的 ERROR 日志
en: Pull today's ERROR logs for order-service.

zh: 下午三点二十左右下单报错，看看后台记录
en: Ordering failed around 3:20 this afternoon. Check what the backend recorded.

zh: grep 一下 OutOfMemory 最近出现几次
en: grep how many times OutOfMemory has shown up recently

zh: 不用看调用链，直接把 nginx 日志里 502 的捞出来
en: Don't bother with the call chain, just pull the 502s out of the nginx logs.

zh: 查下日至里有没有 timeout
en: check the logz for timeout

zh: 帮我查一下 traceID abc123 的调用链
en: Look up the call chain for trace ID abc123.

zh: 这个请求慢在哪一跳，帮我看看链路
en: Which hop is this request slow at? Check the trace.

zh: 下单接口有个请求 3 秒才返回，想看它经过了哪些服务
en: One order API request took 3 seconds. I want to see which services it passed through.

zh: 不看日志了，直接看这次调用的 span 耗时分布
en: Forget the logs, just show me the span timing breakdown for this call.

zh: 帮我 query 一下这个 span 的 parent 是谁
en: Find out which span is this span's parent.

zh: 重启一下 order-service 的 pod
en: Restart the order-service pods.

zh: search-api 有个 pod 卡死了，删了让它重建
en: One search-api pod is frozen. Delete it so it gets recreated.

zh: user-center 那个实例一直 CrashLoopBackOff，先重启试试
en: That user-center instance keeps going into CrashLoopBackOff. Try restarting it first.

zh: 不用扩容，副本数够的，就是有个 pod 状态不对，重启下
en: No need to scale, we have enough replicas. One pod is in a bad state, restart it.

zh: 幫我重啟 gateway 的 pod
en: Restart the gateway pods for me.

zh: 把推荐服务扩到 10 个副本
en: Scale the recommendation service to 10 replicas.

zh: 晚高峰快到了，多开几个实例扛一下
en: Evening peak is coming. Spin up a few more instances to handle it.

zh: HPA 最大副本数调到 20
en: Set the HPA max replicas to 20.

zh: 不用重启，就是流量太大了，加点机器
en: No need to restart. Traffic is just too high, add some capacity.

zh:
用户：活动下周一开始
助手：需要我做什么准备？
用户：promo-service 先缩到 2 个，周一再扩回来
en:
User: The campaign starts next Monday.
Assistant: What should I prepare?
User: Scale promo-service down to 2 for now, and back up on Monday.

zh: 刚发的版本有问题，回滚
en: The release we just pushed is broken. Roll back.

zh: 把 payment 发布到 v2.3.1
en: Deploy payment to v2.3.1.

zh: 新版本上线后错误率飙了，赶紧退回去
en: Error rates spiked after the new version went live. Revert it now.

zh: 不用重启 pod，是镜像版本有 bug，回到上一个版本
en: Restarting pods won't help. The image version has a bug, go back to the previous version.

zh: 幫我把 gateway 回滾到上一個版本
en: Roll the gateway back to the previous version.

zh: 线上出故障了，拉个应急群
en: We have a production outage. Open a war room.

zh: 支付全挂了，影响所有用户，按几级处理
en: Payments are completely down for all users. What severity is this?

zh: 首页打不开半小时了，马上通知所有相关的人
en: The homepage has been down for half an hour. Notify everyone involved right now.

zh: 不是写复盘，是现在正在出事，赶紧上报
en: This isn't about a postmortem. It's happening right now. Report it immediately.

zh: 开个 incident，severity P1
en: Open an incident, severity P1.

zh: 今晚谁值班
en: Who's on call tonight?

zh: 下周的值班表发我一下
en: Send me next week's on-call schedule.

zh: 周六我有事，想跟人换个班
en: I have something on Saturday and want to swap shifts with someone.

zh: 不用拉群，就想知道 DBA 这周谁值班
en: No need for a war room, I just want to know which DBA is on call this week.

zh: 今晚邊個 on call 呀
en: Who's on call tonight, then?

zh: 帮我写上周数据库故障的复盘
en: Help me write the postmortem for last week's database outage.

zh: 去年双十一那次宕机的复盘报告在哪
en: Where's the postmortem report for last year's Double 11 outage?

zh: 领导让我总结一下昨天停机的原因和改进措施
en: My manager wants a summary of yesterday's downtime: the cause and the improvements.

zh: 故障已经恢复了，不用拉群，现在要写复盘
en: The incident is resolved, no war room needed. Now I need to write the postmortem.

zh:
用户：周二那次支付故障
助手：已恢复，持续 23 分钟。
用户：好，把时间线和根因整理成文档
en:
User: That payment outage on Tuesday.
Assistant: Resolved, it lasted 23 minutes.
User: OK, put the timeline and root cause into a document.
